Lumiar — Lisbon, Portugal

🟡 Local press research

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

The Alta de Lisboa area within Lumiar has been the target of repeated PSP drug-trafficking crackdowns, including a major operation in November 2025 (jointly with neighbouring Ameixoeira) that seized weapons and made arrests, and an earlier network dismantled by PSP in 2013 described as the area's 'most active' trafficking group. Correio da Manhã also reported a shooting near a church in Alta de Lisboa and a separate daytime robbery/arrest in Lumiar. Documented incidents concentrate on drug-trafficking operations and isolated violent episodes rather than routine daytime street crime, so night-time risk is rated higher than day. Sources checked: SOL/Sapo, 19 Nov 2025 – "PSP lança megaoperação criminal na Alta de Lisboa e Ameixoeira: Cinco detidos e várias armas apreendidas"; CNN Portugal, 19 Nov 2025 – "Operação policial em curso em Lisboa. PSP faz buscas na Alta de Lisboa e na Ameixoeira"; RTP – "PSP desmantela o 'mais ativo' grupo de tráfico de droga a partir do Lumiar, Lisboa"; Publico, 30 Dec 2013 – "PSP desmantela rede de tráfico de droga no Lumiar em Lisboa"; Correio da Manhã – "Tiroteio junto a igreja na Alta de Lisboa mobiliza PSP"; Correio da Manhã – "Polícias travam ladrão após assalto no Lumiar".
